help: Four curated queries over the virtual schema. Stored history on the pages, such as a head-to-head series since 1897, reads "no virtual table: 0 calls".

queries.title: Fan-out
queries.summary: One team over 2022–2024: 3 slices in parallel
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM "CFBD_VS"."GAMES_TEAMS" WHERE "P_YEAR" BETWEEN 2022 AND 2024 AND "P_TEAM" = 'Michigan'

queries.title: Contradiction
queries.summary: A filter that cannot be true: 0 slices, 0 calls

queries.title: Stored history
queries.sql: SELECT "REQ_SLICE", COUNT(*) AS "REQ_ROWS" FROM "CFBD_VS"."GAMES" WHERE "P_YEAR" BETWEEN 1869 AND 2025 AND "REQ_SOURCE" = 'STORED' GROUP BY "REQ_SLICE" ORDER BY "REQ_SLICE"

queries.title: Over budget
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM "CFBD_VS"."GAMES_TEAMS" WHERE "P_YEAR" BETWEEN 2010 AND 2024 AND "P_TEAM" = 'Michigan'
